summary: Comprehensive testing of AnalytiCore Django REST Framework application completed. Successfully tested backend authentication, admin functionality, and frontend UI. Identified and fixed critical frontend runtime error, and documented remaining backend API issues that prevent full workflow testing.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 520 Server Error instead of successful registration
critical_bugs.impact: New users cannot register for the platform
critical_bugs.likely_cause: Email SMTP configuration issues or emergent integration problems

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error on file upload
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot upload data files to projects - blocks entire data analysis workflow
critical_bugs.likely_cause: Pipeline processing, file storage directory permissions, or missing dependencies

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error on data transformation
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot apply AI-recommended data transformations
critical_bugs.likely_cause: Missing dependencies or pipeline configuration issues
